newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes recover slightly on refinery incident.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes recover slightly on refinery incident.

text.p: Refinery problems at a key U.S. facility bolstered outright domestic crude prices Thursday morning in light market activity.
A series of industry gatherings have emptied many trading offices, and subsequently the movement in grade differentials has steadied after volatility was spotted earlier in the week.
The fluid catalytic cracking unit at Tosco Corp's Bayway, New Jersey plant was temporarily out of action due to a small fire on Wednesday night, supporting the outright uptick.
January West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was trading mid-morning at $23.55-65 a barrel, around 20 cts higher.
